description: Reaction default view folds accepted add and remove assertions by verified Commit position on one authority stream, retaining every assertion for audit.

cases.name: later_remove_hides_add
cases.given: one actor's add at position 10 and remove at position 11 address the same target, key and scope
cases.action: merge the two verified assertion dots in either delivery order and replay duplicates
cases.observed: the default members and audit assertions
assertions: the actor is absent from members regardless of delivery order
both Event dots remain available for audit and duplicates do not change count

cases.name: later_add_restores_member
cases.given: the same actor and partition has remove at position 11 and add at position 12
cases.action: merge the accepted assertions in reverse delivery order
assertions: the actor occurs exactly once because the greatest position is add

cases.name: same_position_conflict_fails_closed
cases.given: different add and remove Events claim the same stream position for one partition
cases.observed: the projection and accepted stream prefix
assertions: no Event ID or arrival order tie breaker selects a winner

cases.name: cross_scope_rejected
cases.given: a reaction target belongs to another effective Circle scope
assertions: the submission produces zero accepted writes

cases.name: redaction_and_revoke_preserve_history
cases.given: an accepted reaction is followed by target redaction and capability revoke
cases.action: submit a new reaction after revoke and rebuild the default view
assertions: the redacted target exposes no reaction summary
the earlier accepted assertion remains historical
the new reaction produces zero writes

cases.name: epoch_rotation_keeps_scope
cases.given: the same emoji is expressed across two MLS epochs with different routing tags
cases.action: fold verified assertions for the same target and effective scope
assertions: different epoch routing tags are not silently deduplicated
neither tag changes the target Event or scope binding
